table.name: TLGNC_CUSTORDER
table.description: Customer orders supporting only Bulk materials and Road direct as a transportation mode for now. A customer order consists of header data (in this table) plus 1 Order-Item (tlgnc_custorder_item). A customer order with N real materials will not be supported. The starting point of an order is always a Shippingpoint (maybe an artificial one), and the end point is always a Shipto. An 'order' is the commercial object for a delivery, the 'assignment' is the logistical object for this.

column.name: CUSTORDER_NUMBER
column.description: The customer order number, used for external systems (output, SAP). Generated independently of CUSTORDER_ID and TLGNC_ORDER.ORDER_NUMBER, based on sequence SLGNC_CUSTORDER_NUMBER.

column.name: LDS_CUSTORDER_NO
column.description: The customer order number defined by the LDS and received in the createCustomerOrderRequest. No logic, not sent to SAP.

column.name: CUSTORDER_CUSTREF_NO
column.description: Reference number as given by the customer. Customer may tell this via phone, or inform later, or via web interface in the future.

column.name: CUSTORDER_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_custorder_status_bs. Status of the customer order. 1=new, 2=open, 3=finished. Comparisons with < and > are forbidden to find out where an order is in the workflow!

column.name: ORDER_CREATION_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_order_creation_type_bs. How the order was generated, 1=Call Center, 2=Web Order, 3=Generated by Logon, 4=Dummy, 5=Pickup Terminal.

column.name: SAP_CONTRACT_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_contract_id. Reference to the contract on which this order is based. Since LOGON 2.0, regular truck orders can only be created based on a valid SAP contract.

column.name: SHIPTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Ship-To of this order, i.e. the place/concrete plant/construction site (Warenempfaenger) where the order is delivered to. The shipto is the end point of the order. If the Shipto is of type 'Location not fixed' the actual delivery coordinates/address are stored in the LNF_... attributes of the order.

column.name: SOLDTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Sold-To of this order, i.e. the customer (Auftraggeber) of this order.

column.name: BILLTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The Bill-To this order has to be billed to (Rechnungsempfaenger). The Bill-To is mandatory; if an order is a free-of-charge-delivery, soldto_sap_bp_id must be set for billto_sap_bp_id as well.

column.name: PAYER_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. Payer of this order, i.e. on which the credit check is done.

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SAREA. Sales Area for this order. The Sales Organisation (TLGNC_SAREA.sorg_cd) is a part of the sales area identifier, besides distribution channel and division.

column.name: POOL_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_pool. Pool to which an order was assigned for delivery. We only support truck orders here, so in all cases pools have a geographic meaning.

column.name: COMM_CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. Commercial Carrier (=Transporteur, Lieferant, Spediteur) who handles the delivery.

column.name: EXEC_CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. Executing Carrier (=ExecutingTransporteur, Lieferant, Spediteur) who handles the delivery, possibly not in Logon. This carrier can be a subcontractor, who must have a partner function with the commercial carrier of the order at the time of the transport. Only possible carriers for this field are carriers flagged executing, or internal. For rail orders, 'SBB' or 'RhB' are possible carriers.

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. The shippingpoint where the order can be loaded/has been loaded = the starting point of the order.

column.name: DELIVERY_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_delivery_type_bs. Delivery type (Lieferart), e.g LKW direkt, Bahn direkt, Bahn-LKW. The value in the order can be overridden over the computed value in the Dispokarte, which is defined by shippingpoint_type_cd of the shippingpoint.

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_DEST_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_distribution_dest_bs. E.g. OUT, INB, IUP, IUD, ... Value depends mainly on tlgns_sap_bp_sarea.distribution_dest_cd of the shipto.

column.name: DELIVERY_FROM_DAT
column.description: Defines the beginning (date and time) of the time frame when the delivery has to happen.

column.name: DELIVERY_TO_DAT
column.description: Defines the end (date and time) of the time frame when the delivery has to happen.

column.name: DELIVERY_TIME_TOLERANCE
column.description: Defines the delivery time window around the planned delivery time of the Single Delivery Order.

column.name: DELIVERY_TIME_TOLERANCE_UOM
column.description: Unit of measure of DELIVERY_TIME_TOLERANCE. HRE = hour, MIN = minute, other units are not supported at the moment.

column.name: DELIVERY_FREQ_EVERY_TIME
column.description: If specified the customer order is supposed to be sliced into sequential Single Delivery Orders with the time difference defined here.

column.name: DELIVERY_FREQ_EVERY_TIME_UOM
column.description: Unit of measure of DELIVERY_FQ_EVERY_TIME_UNIT. HRE = hour, MIN = minute, other units are not supported at the moment.

column.name: DELIVERY_FREQ_QTYPERHRE
column.description: If specified the customer order is supposed to be sliced into Single Delivery Orders so that the specified amount of material is delivered per hour. Also known as performance order.

column.name: DELIVERY_FREQ_QTYPERHRE_UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. Unit of measure of DELIVERY_FREQ_QTYPERHRE.

column.name: CONTACT_PERSON_TXT
column.description: Contact person of the customer for this order. Typically the 'Besteller', and identical to the person that will sign the delivery note. Value is free text, and can be set either by selecting a contact person from the list (from the Dispokarte, tlgnc_shipto_person) or editing the value directly.

column.name: RELEASE_SAP_FLAG
column.description: Whether to release, or hold back an order, i.e. not sending it to SAP immediately on completion. Reason to hold back: unclear prices, manual verification needed, maybe because of unexpected PDA events, dummy customer (not yet in SAP). Flag is only editable if tlgnc_shipto_sarea.release_sap_optional_flag is set OR if flag is 0 (it is always possible to finally set to 'Release SAP')

column.name: FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG
column.description: Defines if order is free of charge for the Customer. Flag is settable to 1 if tlgnc_shipto_sarea.FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG is 1. By default it gets the value of tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG (which also depends on tlgnc_shipto_sarea.FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG), but can be removed manually in order taking.

column.name: SAP_SUPPRESS_MIN_CHARGE_FLAG
column.description: In SAP the customer has to pay a special charge/penalty if he orders a quantity below a defined quantity. Goal is to reduce deliveries which don't utilize the truck fully. Example: if a customer would order only 5 tons then he has to pay transport costs as if the truck had delivered 20 tons plus 5 tons material costs plus penalty. All those cost calculations are done in SAP. LOGON has only the possibility to provide a flag as indication that NO penalty has to be invoiced by SAP.

column.name: TRANSPORT_DUR_PLAN_GOOGLE_MIN
column.description: Transport duration from shipping point to ship-to as calculated by Google.

column.name: TRANSPORT_DISTANCE_M
column.description: Transport distance from shipping point to ship-to in m. For truck orders, Google Maps is used. For rail orders distance information comes from tlgnc_rail_distance. In the case of carrier stock, when in reality the order is not loaded at the shippingpoint stored on order, but from the carrier stock shippingpoint (stored on the assignment), this field is overwritten with the real distance between the carrier stock shippingpoint and the final delivery place (fix shipto place, or in case of LNF shipto, LNF coordinates). Used for logistics aspects.

column.name: PLANNED_UNLOADING_TIME_MIN
column.description: Calculated value stored when the order is created. Value is overridable on call center through an input field named unloading time. If not overridden on the call center, the unloading time is coming from app default, or silo unloading time default depending on the type of the materials in the order (cem/agg)

column.name: ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if an order confirmation note (Bestellbestaetigung) by e-mail should be generated, to the addresses contained in ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this flag has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADRESSES
column.description: E-mail addresses (separated by comma) to be used for order confirmation note and/or delivery note (BB and LS checkboxes in the German user interface). Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this value has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: ORDER_CONF_FAX_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if an order confirmation note (Bestellbestaetigung) by fax should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this flag has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER
column.description: Fax number to be used for order confirmation note and/or delivery note (BB and LS checkboxes in the German user interface). Enter as +41 44 123456, i.e. country code mandatory and only space allowed for grouping. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this value has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: ORDER_CONF_SMS_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if an order confirmation note (Bestellbestaetigung) by SMS should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_SMS_NUMBER. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this flag has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: ORDER_CONF_SMS_NUMBER
column.description: Phone number to be used for order confirmation note (BB checkbox in the German user interface. Delivery note by SMS is not supported). Enter as +41 44 123456, i.e. country code mandatory and only space allowed for grouping. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this value has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: LOAD_CONF_EMAIL_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a load confirmation note by e-mail should be generated, to the addresses contained in ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES.

column.name: LOAD_CONF_FAX_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a load confirmation note by fax should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER.

column.name: LOAD_CONF_SMS_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a load confirmation note by SMS should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_SMS_NUMBER.

column.name: DELIVNOTE_EMAIL_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a delivery note (Lieferschein) by e-mail should be generated, to the addresses contained in ORDER_CONF_EMAIL_ADDRESSES. The flag has an effect during order status set to finished. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this flag has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: DELIVNOTE_FAX_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a delivery note by fax should be generated, to the number contained in ORDER_CONF_FAX_NUMBER. The flag has an effect during order status set to finished. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this flag has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: DELIVNOTE_SINGLE_PAPER_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a delivery note (Lieferschein) on paper should be generated, with the comments contained in order.NOTE_DELIVERY and order_item.ITEM_NOTE_DELIVERY. The flag has an effect during event endLoad. In the case of loading via pickup-terminal application, the function print delivery notes always sets this flag to true, overriding the value from Dispokarte/Order Taking. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this flag has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: DELIVNOTE_COLL_PAPER_FLAG
column.description: Flag to control if a collective delivery note (Lieferschein) on paper should be generated, with the comments contained in order.NOTE_DELIVERY and order_item.ITEM_NOTE_DELIVERY. The flag has an effect during event endLoad. In the case of loading via pickup-terminal application, the function print delivery notes always sets this flag to true, overriding the value from Dispokarte/Order Taking. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this flag has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte!

column.name: CUST_WEBORDER_NOTE
column.description: Notes from the customer for the order. Value is entered by the customer when creating an order in the web-order interface, and cannot be modified by the Call Center Agent. If the note is relevant for other involved persons (Dispatching, Pool), the relevant bits should be copied into the respective note fields by the agent.

column.name: NOTE_ORDER_MGMT
column.description: Notes for the order management about the ship-to. Not modifiable by Call Center Agent. The note is copied from tlgnc_shipto.note_order_mgmt and is set at order creation time. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this value has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte anymore!

column.name: NOTE_DELIVERY
column.description: Additional text for the delivery note (PDF). The note gets its initial text from the ship-to NOTE_DELIVERY, but can be modified for the order. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this value has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte anymore!

column.name: NOTE_DISPATCHING
column.description: Notes for the Dispatching (Pool/Carrier). The note gets its initial text from the ship-to NOTE_DISPATCHING, but can be modified for the order. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this value has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte anymore!

column.name: NOTE_TRUCK_DRIVER
column.description: Notes for the Driver. The note gets its initial text from the ship-to NOTE_TRUCK_DRIVER, but can be modified for the order. Note: In template mechanism Customer Order -> Delivery Order, this value has to be set based on the customer order, i.e. not the Dispokarte anymore!

column.name: ON_HOLD_ORDER_AND_LOCKED_FLAG
column.description: 1=true, if order is a so-called on-hold order and currently 'locked' (German: 'Abrufauftrag'), 0=normal order, or an on-hold order which was unlocked. When set for Truck orders: can be processed until status '6=Dispatched'. When set for Rail orders: can not be transmitted to rail company (but loading/dispatching possible). After those states/actions, the flag is readonly and can not be set again. If true order can be deleted even in status dispatched.

column.name: OPEN_CUSTORDER_FLAG
column.description: If this flag is set then a Single Delivery Order will be created in the first step but when that order is loaded (end loading event) a new Single Delivery Order will be created, schedule and released (if the 'Autom. Release' is checked). This process will be repeated until the Customer Order is manually closed (in order details pop-up or via weighing system interface).

column.name: DELIV_TYPE_PLAN_ACTUAL
column.description: True if the orders delivery type matches the dispo card
